title: Identity document request
summary: A contact asks for identity documents outside a clearly verified process.
scenario: The request combines personal data, urgency, and an unclear destination.
warning_signs: Request through personal chat or an unfamiliar form
Pressure to send a complete document immediately
safe_actions: Pause and verify the organization independently
Ask what minimum information is required
Do not send documents to an unverified destination
recovery_guidance: Ask the recipient to delete an accidental submission when possible
Monitor related accounts and keep the request
reporting_guidance: Keep the request and destination details
false_positive_notes: Some services need identity checks, but a verified purpose and destination should be clear.
